facts.text: We are open Monday to Friday 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM and Saturday 9:00 AM - 1:00 PM. We are closed on Sundays and public holidays.
We are at 42 Maple Street, Suite 3, Springfield, next to the public library.
Free parking is available behind the building. Bus route 7 stops right outside.
Book an appointment online at maplestreetclinic.example/book or call (555) 010-2000. Walk-ins are accepted until 4:00 PM on weekdays.
Please cancel or reschedule at least 24 hours in advance. Late cancellations may incur a $25 fee.
Call us at (555) 010-2000 or email hello@maplestreetclinic.example. For emergencies, call 911.
